item.title: High Debt and Rising Prices Catch Up to Trump, as Midterms Near

item.title: How a California Bill Sparked a MAGA-Sphere Uproar
item.description: A privacy measure for immigration aid workers became a free speech cause for backers of Nick Shirley, a right-wing YouTube star. Democrats say the furor is fueled by misinformation.
item.dc:creator: Laurel Rosenhall
item.media:credit: Andri Tambunan for The New York Times
item.media:description: Nick Shirley, 24, has quickly become a hero in the MAGA movement as a YouTube influencer who has produced viral videos claiming to expose fraud in Democratic-led states.

item.title: In Georgia, Jon Ossoff Courts Broad Appeal With an Anti-Trump Script for Senate Race
item.description: Senator Jon Ossoff, the youngest sitting senator and the only Democrat seeking re-election this year in a state President Trump won in 2024, hasn’t moderated his message in his critical race.
item.dc:creator: Robert Jimison
item.media:description: At rallies across Georgia this summer, Senator Jon Ossoff has delivered a series of blistering rebukes of the president and a challenger for his seat, Representative Mike Collins.

item.title: For Trump, the Iran War Is Stuck Between Combat and Genuine Peace

item.title: James Roche, Embattled Air Force Secretary, Dies at 86

item.title: Hegseth Blocks Promotions of Four Army Officers as Purge Widens
item.description: The turmoil has left a leadership vacuum in the Army at a moment when it is trying to find ways to defend troops against the threat posed by cheap drones.

item.media:description: In 2026, Mr. Hegseth has removed at least 45 officers, selected by boards made up of peers, from promotion lists. More than half of those officers have been female or Black.
